meta.source: FTA National Transit Database, annual agency / mode / type-of-service data, via data.transportation.gov

source_dataset.name: 2025 NTD Annual Data - Service Data and Operating Expenses by Mode (Time Series 2.1)
source_dataset.description:
This dataset details service data and operating expenses, broken out by agency and mode, reported to the National Transit Database for the 2025 report year.

NTD Data Tables organize and summarize data from the 2025 National Transit Database in a manner that is more useful for quick reference and summary analysis.

If you have any other questions about this table, please contact the NTD Help Desk at NTDHelp@dot.gov.

cross_check_dataset.name: 2022 - 2025 NTD Annual Data - Metrics
cross_check_dataset.description:
This dataset details service and cost efficiency metrics for agencies reporting to the National Transit Database in the 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 report years.

Only Full Reporters report data on Passenger Miles. NTD Data Tables organize and summarize data from the National Transit Database in a manner that is more useful for quick reference and summary analysis. This dataset is based on the 2022 - 2025 Federal Funding Allocation, Operating Expenses, and Service database files.

In years 2015-2021, you can find this data in the "Metrics" data table on NTD Program website, at https://transit.d

meta.agency_rows_file: data/transit/ntd_agency_mode_annual.csv (every row carries source_dataset, source_url, report_year)
meta.dollars: nominal US dollars of the report year (not inflation-adjusted); NTD report year is the agency fiscal year
meta.vehicle_unit_note: for rail modes the NTD counts revenue hours and miles per railcar (vehicle), not per train

avg_trip_miles.formula: passenger miles traveled / unlinked passenger trips

vrh_per_route_mile.unit: vehicle revenue hours per directional route mile
vrh_per_route_mile.formula: vehicle revenue hours / directional route miles

meta.quartile_method: linear interpolation between order statistics (inclusive method, as numpy default)
meta.row_rules: agency-mode-type-of-service rows with mode_status Operating, numerator and denominator both above zero, no trimming of outliers

cuts.top50_upt: the 50 qualifying rows with most unlinked passenger trips in that mode and year (only where at least 5)

caveats: Report years 2020 and 2021 are pandemic years; use 2023 to latest for planning.
Fare revenue for purchased-transportation (PT) rows is allocated differently in some agencies; this table and NTD's Metrics table disagree on fares for a small share of rows (see the audit file).
Medians describe existing agencies, not a new line; a new line's cost can differ from the median of established systems.

evaluate_transit_loader_arguments.note: documentation only; evaluateTransit does not read these yet. Suggested injected argument ctx.operatingBenchmarks.

shape.ridershipValidation: rows of data/transit/station_boardings.csv: {system, station, lat, lon, avg_weekday_boardings, year, mode, source_url}

evaluate_transit_loader_arguments.how_to_derive: operating cost per year = vehicle revenue hours (service plan) x opex_per_vrh; fare revenue = trips x fare_per_upt; gap = operating cost - fare revenue; return null if any input is missing
